purpose: Compose the new degree(4,4,5) certificate with an already accepted baseline rather than rerun or silently trust a fresh lower-degree construction.
assumption: The prior acceptance is trusted from the earlier exercised independent run; the new verifier requires its externally supplied certificate digest and records the acceptance-file digest. It does not re-execute all baseline degrees.
full_reproduction: Run the README baseline height12 checker first, then the new checker with the exact trusted digest. A standalone new-degree PASS is not advertised as a recheck of the baseline.
range_extension_argument: A first extra relation in a rank3 GCM must have all coordinates >=2 and A alpha<=0. For A_one and total height13, these imply 3a<=13, 3b<=13, 4a+3b>=26; thus a=b=4,c=5 is the only candidate.
